gaps.fact: The Cantabrian Mountains to the north put Castilla y León in a rain shadow. The chapter says only that the plateau is far from any sea, and no stem or article line names the range for the Duero regions.

Ribera del Duero's own ageing minimums for red: Crianza two years with one in oak, Reserva three with one in oak, Gran Reserva five with two in oak. The article, the country record and one region question teach them; no chapter fact and no stem in either bank asks Ribera's figures (every bank stem on the ladder is Rioja's or the national floor).

Martinsancho, the Court's Rueda house, appears nowhere in the Codex; Pesquera and Descendientes de J. Palacios stand only in the articles and the producer entries, and only Vega Sicilia is the key of a stem.

notes: Mapped questions: Régionale 59 (Spain), Village 37 (Spain), 96 in all; by stem the Castilian share is 11 Régionale (i-e3aki34e, i-758hg9hv, i-j7nlj6xu, i-kjmt0835, i-hoix2bti, i-ugzpn1t4, i-lnrrwhl5, i-a455nccq, i-5uvki45k, with the Tempranillo stems i-8lrwa2oc and i-nzd8uqd8) and 7 Village (c-pae5s8z1, c-4hy31gcr, c-lalvjliu, c-6pdk121a, c-nuhfpyh7, c-9ps3vyje, c-vrqrmp6q). The Village stems reach well past the Court (Cigales, Arribes, Prieto Picudo, Albillo Mayor), while the one Certified figure the Court prints, Ribera's ageing ladder, is never asked in either bank. Everything else is taught: the meseta, the diurnal swing, the Duero becoming the Douro, Verdejo and Rueda Sauvignon, the three Tempranillo names, Toro, Bierzo's Mencía and Vega Sicilia. The Court's Ribera Gran Reserva of five years with two in oak matches the article (60 months, at least 24 in barrel, the rest in bottle). No errors found. One search spent, on Ribera del Duero: no amendment since 2023 creates a category or moves the ageing minimums (the ministry's list shows the ageing periods corrected in 2014 to 2015, the white Albillo Mayor wine added in 2019, organoleptic updates in 2022 and a vineyard register change in April 2025), so nothing is logged as a court update. Card, fact and trap numbers count from one.
